for xibar=0, Gamma_kl(xi,xi) = eps_jikl contracted with the 2x2 minors of the 2x4 matrix xi_alpha^i: vanishes iff rank xi <= 1; [xi,xi] = Gamma|_V = 0 for every xi in S_+ (x) W (prop:c2-special); rank-two elements = topological twists (ESW Sec 10.3 bullet 2)

evaluation_along_xi.lemma_arity_D: arity-k component on (xi,...,xi) of O (weight w_O, ghost |O|): weight w_O + k/2, ghost |O|+1-k; pair entry (w_in,g_in)->(w_out,g_out) has k = 2(w_out - w_in) = 1 + g_in - g_out (consistency check); field-only outputs: k <= |O|+1
evaluation_along_xi.lemma_S2_D: S^(2)(xi,xi) has only lambda*-legs; P(eps,infty) has components A(x)A, c(x)A*, A*(x)c, lambda(x)lambda only; each graph of the UV-boundary expansion has at most one field-antifield pairing; so S^(2) is joined only through it and its second lambda*-leg is external: at one loop S^(2) contributes only to outputs with lambda*; field-only (xi,xi) outputs come from graphs with two S^(1)(xi) vertices; no one-loop (xi,xi) counterterm from S^(2) graphs; S^(2) enters field-only data through the (xi,xi) master equation (lem:c2-components) and through antifield representatives of twisted letters
